description: With output_format='python', the SQL text is wrapped in a single-quoted Python string literal. OutputPythonFilter._process escapes quotes in each token but not backslashes, so a backslash in front of a quote in the SQL text turns into an escaped backslash followed by a quote that closes the literal. The rest of the SQL text is then Python code in the generated snippet.

finding.message: Text is placed in a generated string literal with quotes escaped but backslashes not.
